theme: Open water, open calendar — a few land-side bookings to close.
greeting: You're mid-charter on the Adriatic, Dan, with nothing on the calendar. The only real pull today is dry-land logistics before the boat's signal thins — the Cavtat arrival, and a couple of bookings that don't want to wait.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat arrival details
needsAttention.detail: The Remisens hotel for the 19th is booked, but the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, an early bag hold, and the 5:15 AM checkout for your 7:30 flight are all still open. Free cancellation ends Sept 15, and these need doing from shore while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Book it refundable now while dates can still shift — this is the item most likely to bite if left.

needsAttention.title: Book the Florida rental car
needsAttention.detail: Full-size SUV, TPA, Sept 20 to Oct 5 — no longer a hedge now the Pathfinder is being driven down. You land jet-lagged on a Sunday; don't arrive without it. Overdue since Sept 9.

flagged.title: Philip is checking in from Maine
flagged.detail: An old friend wrote — summer got away from you both, and he leaves Saturday for two weeks in the Med, hoping to find a time to connect.

flagged.title: Ethics & Boards connection request
flagged.detail: David at the governance-data firm Ethics & Boards sent a LinkedIn invite — worth a glance given the board search.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promos — Responsible Investor, ICGN policy, Folio Society, Maine seafood and cast iron.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: Early autumn brings in the first beets and bitter chicories worth roasting and searing against a good chop.

tasks.title: Confirm the Nautilus return transfer for the 19th
Check the St Pete Airbnb converted from pending

acts.line: A clear calendar and open water — nothing pulls at the morning.
The best window to clear the Cavtat transfers and the two bookings before the signal thins.
Nothing scheduled tonight — an easy evening aboard before Cavtat on the 19th.
